svg.title: Running proportion of sixes in two simulated runs of 1,000 fair-die rolls
svg.desc: Line plot of the running proportion of sixes over 1,000 simulated rolls in two runs. After 10 rolls Run A is at 0.40 and Run B at 0; both settle near the dashed line at 1/6, ending at 0.161 and 0.167.
svg.text: Proportion of rolls that were a six
